messages:
Riley (Finance Manager): Quick announcement — we're updating the quarterly p-card audit flow and adding a short one-time supplier exception window. Please read: submit receipts + any exception requests by Apr 8. Confluence: https://confluence.redwoodinternal/finance/pcard-audit (details + template).
Priya (People Ops): Thanks — is this replacing the monthly reconcile reminder or an extra step?
Riley (Finance Manager): Extra step this quarter only to clear a backlog of legacy vendor exceptions. Monthly reconciles still required.
Marcos (Eng): For purchases made via team shared cards (platform infra), do we file exceptions per charge or per vendor?
Riley (Finance Manager): Per charge, please. If multiple charges share the same explanation, note that in the exception form so AP sees context.
Sam (Procurement): Who can approve an exception? Our vendor onboarding team has some pre-approved partners that might need waive.
Riley (Finance Manager): Delegated approvers: team manager + procurement lead. For pre-approved partners, mark the box on the form and tag @Procurement for fast-track review.
ProcurementBot: Reminder: any outstanding p-card charges older than 30 days will be auto-flagged in the audit report on Apr 9. Pull your receipts now to avoid follow-ups.
Priya (People Ops): Will there be a simpler CSV for mass uploads? Some teams reconcile many charges at once.
Riley (Finance Manager): Yes — CSV template is on the Confluence page (link above). Quick note in the form header about required columns.
Jenna (AP): I'll run the flagged report on Apr 9 and start exception triage. If teams need expedited review, DM me and cc procurement.
Marcos (Eng): Can we get a quick office hours slot? Two engineers on my team will need help mapping internal project codes to GL accounts.
Riley (Finance Manager): Yep — office hours scheduled Apr 3 10–11am PT (Zoom link on page). If that doesn't work, drop times and we'll add more slots.
Sam (Procurement): Appreciated. Also: does this affect vendor invoice approvals or just p-card charges?
Riley (Finance Manager): Just p-card charges and the one-time exception window. Vendor invoice workflow unchanged.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. We'll ping eng leads to remind their ICs to upload receipts.
Riley (Finance Manager): Thanks — couple action items: 1) upload receipts now, 2) use the exception form for any missing backup, 3) reach out during office hours for mapping questions. Short summary: deadline Apr 8. :calendar: :memo:
ProcurementBot: Confirmed — deadline Apr 8. Automated reminders will post Apr 1 and Apr 6.
Jenna (AP): Will add to my calendar. If anyone needs the CSV template emailed, ping me and I'll send it.
Marcos (Eng): Sending to the team now. Thanks Riley. :thumbsup:
Riley (Finance Manager): TY everyone — appreciate the quick turn.
